summary: Verified both quality fixes on the Warm Pipeline page (/business/referrals). BACKEND: Regenerated fresh outreach drafts (force=true) for the 3 leads with strong referrer testimonials (Jason Post, Marcelo Lebre, Pujun Bhatnagar). All 3 drafts (a) explicitly say 'your contact Deepthi Rao' in the email_body, (b) contain a real quoted excerpt whose words verifiably match a 4+ consecutive-word run from the actual referrer_testimonial (not a generic paraphrase), and (c) the linkedin_message also opens by naming the referrer as 'your contact Deepthi Rao'. FRONTEND: Column order on warm-leads-table is exactly Lead / Recent activity / Signals / Stage / Referred on / Referred by. Role/company subtitle under each lead's name has computed textTransform='uppercase' (renders as e.g. 'PRESIDENT AT POST HOSPITALITY GROUP', 'FOUNDER & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AT LAYERPATH'). Referred-on cell is narrow (~96px) with two stacked lines ('Jul 24' + time). +N more toggle on Signals expands cleanly (verified rows with +8/+10/+11 more). Row click opens warm-lead-drawer with full enrichment + Referral Agent panel. Intelligent Action panel at top shows real computed data (Vinay Chandrasekaran, 12 signals, Send LinkedIn InMail). No console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: build_outreach_prompt() cleanly conditionalizes the 'strong testimonial' requirement via is_strong_testimonial (>=40 chars) — good threshold; forces a real quoted excerpt only when the source is substantive enough to quote.
The 'your contact {referrer}' instruction is repeated in the system prompt for both email_body and linkedin_message — verified LLM consistently obeys across 3 different leads with force=true.

ReferralAgentPage.jsx: table columns use fixed thead widths (min-w-[220px]/[280px]/[260px], w-[92px]) — good for stable layout; SignalsCell max-w bumped to 280/320 as claimed. formatDateShort splits into date+time spans cleanly.
No search/filter input exists on this page. Not a bug per current design, but review request mentions 'filters/search' — worth confirming with product whether that was intended for a future round.
